missing: PEG-IFN-SA (peginterferon alfacon-2, Paiyisheng, Beijing Kawin) was approved by China NMPA in June 2018 for adult chronic hepatitis C after phase Ib, II (NCT01908335, primary cEVR, 212 pts) and III (NCT01903278, primary SVR vs Pegasys/RBV, 719 pts, completed 2015-08; no registry results). Sources: https://www.kawin.com.cn/news/information/2023/0724/151.html ; https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E5%9F%B9%E9%9B%86%E6%88%90%E5%B9%B2%E6%89%B0%E7%B4%A0%CE%B1-2%E6%B3%A8%E5%B0%84%E6%B6%B2/67337319 . The draft's efficacy and tile note stop at the 2016 phase 1b; the phase 3 success/approval is the class's furthest outcome and should be recorded (patient side), and the tile note 'only PEG-IFN-SA published patient data' should mention approval.

Earlier monkey PK work on pegylated consensus interferon: Cao 2009, Immunopharmacol Immunotoxicol 31:543 (doi 10.3109/08923970902814111), rhesus serum ELISA, cited by Zheng 2014 as ref 15; if this is PEG-IFN-SA, model_first_use_year for the monkey tracks is 2009, not 2011 (not verified).
Nonclinical toxicology of PEG-IFN-SA was completed for the NMPA filing (Kawin states pharmacology/toxicology done) but is not public; safety untested/unpublished stands.

No source found for Hanferon (any model or patient data), nor any HCV replicon, chimeric-liver mouse or patient-cell model compared with patients for these three members (Europe PMC and web search, not exhaustive).
rule_questions: When a class enters patients on an in-vivo serum bioactivity (bioassay) model in a species the virus cannot infect, does that model's generic claim of 'sustained in vivo antiviral action' count as an efficacy prediction that HCV RNA will fall (scorable same), or only as engagement, leaving efficacy untested/no_prediction?
Is a non-US/EU regulator approval (China NMPA, 2018) with no public review document an admissible tier 2 source, or only tier 5 (sponsor statement), for recording a phase 3 success?
